event.title: The FSFE at the 11th edition of Software Freedom Kosova in Pristina, Kosovo

body.p: The Free Software Foundation Europe will take part in this year's edition of Software Freedom Kosova, taking place October 1–3, 2026, with a talk on our 25-year history.

FSFE's project manager, Dario Presutti, will be at SFK 2026 to talk about the long road to software freedom. The FSFE turned 25 this year and, since 2001, has worked to empower users to control technology. This talk traces the many fronts of that effort: legal, political, technical, and community-based. The talk will take place on October 2.
Let us know if you'll be around!
